definitions.explanation: A gesture indicating uncertainty, resignation, or indifference by raising both shoulders.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{肩|かた}をすくめた。
⟦{仕方|しかた}がない→仕方がない：07380_shikataganai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{肩|かた}をすくめる⟦しか→しか：09959_shika⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I could only shrug, thinking there was nothing to be done.

examples.japanese: ⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}えず→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧、{肩|かた}をすくめた。
examples.english: Instead of answering the question, she just shrugged.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}いながら→言う：00515_iu⟧{肩|かた}をすくめる⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: Watching him shrug while saying "I don't know," I believed he really didn't know.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}かれて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧{肩|かた}をすくめる⟦だけ→だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: When asked why she was late, she could only shrug awkwardly.

notes:
STRUCTURE: ⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧ (shoulder) + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ + ⟦すくめる→すくめる：10357_sukumeru⟧ (to draw in, to hunch). The verb ⟦すくめる→すくめる：10357_sukumeru⟧ is used almost only in this phrase and in ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すくめる→すくめる：10357_sukumeru⟧.

GESTURE MEANING: A shrug conveys one of:
- "I don't know"
- "It can't be helped" (⟦{仕方|しかた}がない→仕方がない：07380_shikataganai⟧)
- resignation or indifference
- deliberate non-commitment

CULTURAL NOTE: Shrugging is a Western gesture more than a traditional Japanese one, but it is widely understood in Japan, especially among younger speakers and in international settings. A speaker who would shrug in English often says 「⟦{仕方|しかた}がない→仕方がない：07380_shikataganai⟧」 instead, or tilts the head.

RELATED GESTURE EXPRESSIONS:

- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧: to raise one's hand — volunteering, or surrender

OTHER {肩|かた} EXPRESSIONS:

- ⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧: to relax, to stop straining
